auth.storage: Secure Vault via authd surrogate exchange — the raw key is never printed, logged, or persisted

description: BirdEye market data inside Muse: Solana token prices, OHLCV, 30m tape (trades/buys/sells/wallets), token overview, trending, meme launches, pair overview, search, and wallet PnL — through one authenticated connector.
name: birdeye
plan_notes: Some endpoints (token_security, token_creation_info, token/meta-data, token/fee, blockchain-metrics, smart-money) return 401 on lower-tier keys. The skill documents per-endpoint availability and degrades honestly instead of retry-looping.
rate_limits: Pace calls (~1.2s apart) with backoff on 429. Prefer one token_overview call per mint; it carries the full 30m tape.

mcp.note: Access BirdEye market data through our own musebook.trade OAuth (mcp-auth) — sign in once with your Solana wallet. Direct X-API-KEY auth to public-api.birdeye.so remains available via the custom.birdeye connector.
